page.layout: One page of text, one column; notes in the left margin (faint edge letters only, not transcribed as notes).

main_text.l: Tam non potest confensus esse in
malo, ut finistri illi patroni non in-
ter se tantum differant, sed ipsi à
facit, ut, qui studiò velit premere
illa omnia, quæ publicè exstant sub
velo Galeni, posse ex ipso Gal. in
jam abundè factum est in liene, in
neo, in unitate animæ, in aliis mul-
tis: satis nunc efto studii. Intereà
fremant isti, q. ad Sirenum cantus
mando, negando: quid id ad me? ἀ
ἔυμεὶ ἐμῆ. At, ὁ vos tales, soleo

page.notes: Faint, partly illegible Greek words; "ANRA" in the scan reads ADRA; several words in the upper portion are heavily blurred and transcribed as best possible. Left-edge letters are from the neighbouring page and are omitted.
